rationale: Wing Chuen Lam brings hands-on mechatronic engineering experience from robotics hardware roles at The Robot Works and MEKA Inc., while AJ Chahal is building Seed Physical around dexterous robotic manipulation with deep expertise in hardware-software co-design. They share core focus on robotics-manipulation and could exchange valuable perspectives on engineering challenges and practical approaches to robot learning and system integration.
intro_message: Wing Chuen Lam, meet AJ Chahal — you both work on dexterous robotic systems, and AJ is actively building hardware solutions for real-world manipulation tasks where your mechatronic engineering background could be insightful.
